mentions.name: AI Hacker Newsletter
mentions.description: A weekly newsletter built on top of Hacker News that features the most upvoted and discussed links, branded as AI-focused. Started in November 2025 and currently at 1,150 subscribers with steady 40-45% open rates and 7-8% click rates, with a goal of reaching 2,000 subscribers by the one-year anniversary.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on AI Hacker Newsletter, a weekly newsletter on top of Hacker News, with the most upvoted and discussed links.
mentions.author: alexgotoi
